ledger_scope.DAG: all-node order longest common prefix at mining end / mining rounds, excluding genesis; current agreement, not finality

throughput_scopes.total: both protocols: all generated non-genesis blocks / actual mining rounds
throughput_scopes.eventual: potential utilization proxy: Bitcoin original main count / rounds; DAG generated / rounds assuming valid blocks eventually disseminate and enter the order; not measured network capacity
throughput_scopes.current_order: Bitcoin original main count / rounds; DAG all-node order common prefix / rounds
throughput_scopes.bitcoin_original_main: num_of_valid_blocks unchanged: common prefix of global selected chain and height-selected honest nodes, controlled by consensus_miner_quantile; default -1 selects one longest honest node
throughput_scopes.reference_ordered: DAG reference-node metric retained for local diagnostics; not used for the common-order curve

seed_band: observed min/max, not confidence interval; deterministic PoW seeds need not be independent
